channels.name: Dout+ / Dout-
channels.purpose: Outbound Data signal of the link.

channels.name: Sout+ / Sout-
channels.purpose: Outbound Strobe signal (toggles when Data does not).

channels.name: Din+ / Din-
channels.purpose: Inbound Data signal of the link.

channels.name: Sin+ / Sin-
channels.purpose: Inbound Strobe signal (DS partner of Din).

global_signals.name: Logical address
global_signals.purpose: Identifies a destination node (32..255) for logical-address routing.

global_signals.name: Time-Code
global_signals.purpose: 6-bit system-time value broadcast across the network.

handshake_pairs.name: NULL exchange
handshake_pairs.rule: Both ends send/receive NULLs in Started to confirm the link is connected.

handshake_pairs.name: FCT exchange
handshake_pairs.rule: An FCT in Connecting/Run grants eight N-Chars of credit.

handshake_pairs.name: Time-Code
handshake_pairs.rule: Broadcasts and forwards the 6-bit system time.

dependency_graph.common_rule: A link must run the exchange FSM (ErrorReset -> ErrorWait -> Ready -> Started -> Connecting -> Run), exchanging NULLs and FCTs, before any data character flows. Routers forward packets by wormhole routing using the leading address character.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: A data character (N-Char) requires: (1) the link in Run, (2) FCT credit > 0. Each FCT grants eight N-Chars; up to 56 may be outstanding. A packet ends with EOP/EEP.

logical_signaling_levels.name: NULL (idle)
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Link active but no data in flight; ESC+FCT keep-alive.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Run / data
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Link in Run; data characters flow under FCT credit.

ordering_rules.bit_order_on_wire: LVDS Data/Strobe; data character bits LSB first; clock = Data XOR Strobe.
ordering_rules.character_order: Address characters precede cargo; EOP/EEP terminates a packet.
ordering_rules.credit: An N-Char is sent only while FCT credit remains.
ordering_rules.routing: Routers forward by wormhole routing as soon as the header is decoded.
